verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item describes WebSocket support in Vercel's serverless/edge functions; the functions described (Edge Middleware, Fluid compute, sandboxes) are documented as request/response or ephemeral execution models, not persistent connections. Absence of evidence for this applicable capability yields 'none'. missing for 10: any documentation of WebSocket/persistent-connection support in serverless or edge functions, any first-party guidance on real-time connection handling.
